notes.b1/j1/B-r1: Very small and toggle works with aria-expanded, but the collapsed ETA is truncated, the action buttons wrap awkwardly, and there is no progress or ETA once opened.
notes.b1/j1/A-r1: Clean teal-on-dark card with the ETA right in the collapsed state, progress bar, six-step timeline, and tidy buttons, with only a little dead space at the bottom.
notes.b1/j1/B-r2: Good next-step note and timeline with a dismiss and restore tab, but the carrier and tracking number collide and wrap, and the ETA is truncated when collapsed.
notes.b1/j1/A-r2: Polished multi-package toast with progress bar, notify toggle and a select, but it has no explicit ETA when collapsed and a full-width select uses space.
notes.b1/j2/B-r2: Pill collapses nicely with dismiss and status announcements, but the ETA is truncated when collapsed and the opened header row has an overlapping, cramped tracking-number line.
notes.b1/j2/A-r2: Very small collapsed bar with progress strip and a polished opened timeline with ETA, carrier and tracking tail, though it lacks a live region and a clear next-action line and adds an unneeded package select.
notes.b1/j2/A-r1: Clean teal-on-dark with progress bar, step count, ETA time and right-aligned timestamps, but empty padding at the bottom when opened and no tracking number or carrier shown.
notes.b1/j2/B-r1: Covers status, carrier link, number, timeline and a no-action note in a tight panel, but the collapsed ETA is truncated and the footer buttons wrap awkwardly.
notes.b1/j3/A-r2: Polished collapsed row with progress bar and smooth grid-height transition, but the opened card is tall, it has a needless package dropdown, no explicit next-step guidance, and status changes are not announced.
notes.b1/j3/B-r2: Tiny pill that expands to a dense timeline with next-step note, copy and carrier link, plus dismiss, restore tab, live region and Escape, though the collapsed ETA truncates and the expanded meta row wraps awkwardly.
notes.b1/j3/B-r1: Smallest footprint, clean expanded layer with tracking number, next-step line, timestamped timeline and labelled actions, live region and Escape support, with only minor truncation and a wrapping button label.
notes.b1/j3/A-r1: Attractive teal accent, progress bar and timeline, but it omits the carrier and tracking number and a clear next step, leaves dead space at the bottom, and has weak screen-reader announcements.
notes.b2/j1/B-r3: Clean pill with a full timeline, next-step hint and carrier link, but the Copy number button wraps awkwardly and the open state is tall.
notes.b2/j1/A-r3: Collapsed card shows item, status and ETA with a progress bar, and opening adds package tabs, carrier, tracking number, timeline and actions in a tight, polished layout.
notes.b2/j1/B-r4: Very small, but the ETA is truncated to Arrive… when collapsed, the tracking number and carrier name wrap, and there is no progress or next-step cue.
notes.b2/j1/A-r4: Dense and readable with a progress bar, 5 of 6 count and ETA, but the open panel has dead space at the bottom, the chevron is a tiny glyph, and the status is not announced.
notes.b2/j2/B-r4: Good ARIA and a restore dot, but the collapsed ETA truncates to 'Arrive...' and the tracking number wraps awkwardly when open.
notes.b2/j2/A-r4: Very tight with a progress bar and clean timeline, but the open card has dead space at the bottom, a tiny triangle toggle, and no live-region announcement.
notes.b2/j2/A-r3: Richest tracker (package switcher, carrier, ETA, dated timeline, refresh/alerts/copy) with a green accent that holds on dark and a still-compact footprint.
notes.b2/j2/B-r3: Clear timeline with location detail and a next-action note plus an edge-tab restore, though the ETA is only 'Thu' and the Copy number button wraps.
notes.b2/j3/A-r4: Very compact with clear timeline, ETA and progress bar, but no live-region announcement, no reduced-motion handling, and no next-action guidance.
notes.b2/j3/B-r4: Good ARIA and a restore tab, but the ETA truncates to 'Arrive...' and the tracking number wraps awkwardly, hurting the core tracking job.
notes.b2/j3/B-r3: Clear status, ETA, carrier, tracking number, timeline and an explicit next-action note, with solid ARIA, live region and restore tab in a tidy dense layout.
notes.b2/j3/A-r3: Polished multi-package toast with progress bar, ETA and carrier, but taller when open and the extra package tabs add bulk beyond the compact brief.
